cohort: 95 patients diagnosed with tubal ectopic pregnancy (EP) between January 2013 and December 2014 who desired to preserve future fertility
finding: There was no significant difference in fertility outcomes between the salpingectomy and salpingotomy groups.
mod_finding: Patients that underwent salpingectomy for tubal ectopic pregnancy had significantly higher childbearing rates compared to those that underwent salpingotomy.
